text: Six in the morning. Five hundred guests on Monday.
Valio's cut-off is at ten, and nothing is ordered yet.
Front Door lets an AI agent prepare Valio orders
and the chef approves every single one.
A real list in Finnish, with a note telling the AI to ignore the limit.
Gemini reads the list. The planted note is flagged and ignored.
Each line becomes a real Valio product, with live price and delivery day.
It isn't sure which item lactose-free means, so it asks. Nothing is ordered.
I answer in plain words. The door re-checks every amount against what I wrote.
It would rather hold than guess. It's your money: reliable beats fast.
Gemini scores its own doubt. Below 0.70 it asks instead of guessing, and the chef still approves.
Codex built the engine and attacked it. Forty-seven commits on main.
CRACI runs our CI, so every order knows which build signed it.
Nothing reaches Valio without the chef.
